Then the number of elements in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><munderover><mo largeop="true">∩</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mn>100</mn></munderover><msub><mi>T</mi><mi>n</mi></msub></math> is _____.

solution.text:
Given,

A=-1a0b

A2=-1a0b-1a0b=1-a+ab0b2

∴Tn=A∈S;Ana+1=I

∴  b must be equal to 1

∴ In this case A2  will become identity matrix and a can take any value from 1 to 100

∴ Total number of common element will be 100.
